Although it is not clearly elucidated whether HMB alone attenuate sarcopenic symptom, HMB plus vibration improve signiﬁ-
cantly this. Whole body vibration and local vibration have been implemented as treatment for muscle weakness in the elderly.
One RCT using sarcopenic men (mean age 88.6 years) indicated that 8-week vibration (12–16 Hz, 3–5 mm) signiﬁcantly improved
muscle strength and physical performance (gait speed, ﬁve-times-sit-to-stand test, and timed-up-and-go test) (Zhu et al., 2019).
